name: LODESTAR NETWORKS
notes:
Lodestar Networks is a UK independent mobile network and voice platform. Our core is hosted at Telehouse London Docklands North Two.

Peering
- Open peering policy, no ratio or contract requirements
- IPv4 and IPv6 supported
- Please send requests to peering@lodestarnetworks.co.uk with your ASN, the exchange or facility, and the IP addresses you would like to peer on
- We register our routes in the RIPE IRR and filter on IRR data and RPKI, so please make sure your own objects are up to date

Contacts
- Peering: peering@lodestarnetworks.co.uk
- NOC: noc@lodestarnetworks.co.uk
- Abuse: abuse@lodestarnetworks.co.uk
